_readme: Injector handlers whose target is EXPECTED to be absent on one Minecraft version, read by
tools/verify_mixin_targets.py. Keys are Minecraft versions; only the key matching the jar on
the verifier's classpath is read, so a key starting with '_' is documentation.
One jar serves 1.20.1 through 1.20.4. Two client mixins cover a method shape that changes
inside that range by declaring one arm per shape, each with require = 0 and expect = 0, so
exactly one arm resolves on any single version. Pointing the verifier at one version's jar
therefore reports the other arm's target as genuinely absent. Listing the arm here turns that
report into a note; an unlisted absent target is still a failure, and an entry that never
fires is a failure in its own right, so this file cannot outlive the split it documents.
Minecraft.doWorldLoad leads with a level-id String on 1.20.1 and 1.20.2 and drops it on
1.20.3 and 1.20.4. WorldOpenFlows publishes loadLevel(Screen, String) on 1.20.1 and 1.20.2
The loading screen's two percentage redirects are the third such pair, and they are
deliberately NOT listed: both GuiGraphics.drawCenteredString overloads are declared on every
supported version, and only the call site inside LevelLoadingScreen.render differs. The
verifier cannot see inside a method body, so it reports neither arm as absent on any version
and listing either one would be stale. Their split is covered by require = 0 alone.
